items.evidence: Loop aspirates 18 uL from master_mix_reservoir A1 and dispenses into each of the 96 pcr_plate wells with p20; end_state:pcr_plate passes.
Step 2 and step 3 loops move 1 uL from each colony/primer well to the matching pcr_plate well with p20, giving 20 uL; end-state checks pass.
pick_up_p20() and drop_tip() are called per well in steps 2 and 3; the one tip in step 1 only serves master mix into empty wells; no_cross_contamination passes.
Step 4 comment records sealing and 98C 30 s; [98C 10 s, 60C 30 s, 72C 30 s] x 30; 72C 2 min; hold 4C.
Follows the specified steps in order, including the 3x mix after template; apiLevel 2.15 is allowed and the comments and metadata are accurate with no invented steps.

judge.summary: The protocol simulates cleanly and every measured check passes. It dispenses 18 uL master mix, then 1 uL template with a 3x mix and 1 uL primer per well, using a fresh tip per sample, and records the seal and thermocycling comment.
